summary: Schmitz Mountain, Sanders County, Montana: 72-foot steel L-4 tower built 1935 on the Flathead Indian Reservation, named staff in 1955 and 1959, listed gone.

facts.design: 72' steel tower with L-4 cab quarters
facts.status_note: firelookout.com marks the tower Gone; firelookout.org lists Tower Gone; no removal date in these sources.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives seven miles southeast of Hot Springs; the 1955 item quoted on the Forest Lookouts page gives about twenty miles by road. The sources do not say whether they measure the same way.
The 1955 item spells the station Schmidt Lookout; firelookout.com, the Forest Lookouts page heading and firelookout.org use Schmitz.

notes_for_editor: The brief had no agency; 'Flathead Indian Agency' comes from the Forest Lookouts page, while firelookout.com gives only the reservation. The 1955 and 1959 newspaper items are known only through quotes on the Forest Lookouts page; searches did not locate the originals. The distance and name spelling conflicts are unresolved. A search hit describing a 1935 72-foot steel tower was for Blue Mountain in Lincoln County, a different site, and is not used. The sources say nothing about access on reservation land, so any visit guidance needs input from the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes. No photo credit used (firelookout.com credits a photo to Dave Masters, but no image URL was retrieved).
